items.question: Do I need to be a US resident to invest?
items.answer: No. We regularly work with foreign national investors, including buyers based in France and Québec, and can guide you through financing, legal and tax considerations with our partner network.

items.question: Which areas do you invest in?
items.answer: We focus on Broward and Miami-Dade counties in South Florida, including Lauderhill, Hollywood, Fort Lauderdale and Miami, where rental demand is strongest.

items.question: How long does a turnkey project take?
items.answer: On average, 4 to 8 months from signed acquisition to a leased, income-producing property, depending on the scope of renovation.

items.question: Can you manage the property after it's leased?
items.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing property management so you can keep investing hands-off, wherever you are.

story.title: From France to Florida
paragraphs: Artae was founded in France to make rental investing simple, transparent and accessible — handling sourcing, renovation, furnishing and management under one roof. The group has since delivered more than 300 projects for investors across France.

ARTAE USA LLC, based in Lauderhill, Florida, extends that same turnkey model to the US market. We work with American investors as well as French and Québec-based buyers looking to diversify into US real estate, offering a fully bilingual experience end to end.
Our team combines on-the-ground knowledge of South Florida's rental market with the operational rigor developed over hundreds of projects abroad.
